text: - **0071 — Publish intents & route provenance.** Keeps legacy decision 0064's single write doorway but separates construction → finalization → signing → publishing as stages of *one actor-owned workflow*. Draft builders are allowed (composable, ergonomic) but must not sign/publish/choose relays as side effects. Every explicit relay route must carry a typed **provenance class** (automatic / host-pin / verified-private-inbox / manual / imported / diagnostic). Private routes fail closed without verified-inbox provenance. Dispatch acceptance/queued state is **never** terminal publish success.
